title: Living-Infrastructure conserved-flow and system contracts
reason: Living Infrastructure was registered in kueper-ecosystem (docs/programs/living-infrastructure.md) as the integration layer joining mycology/soil ecology, closed-loop life support, agriculture, waste/recycling, Planetary Evolution and future ecopoiesis. Engineering owns the conserved-flow and system contracts, but no stable contract currently exists for the shared mass, water, carbon/nutrient and energy reservoirs that KG identities and downstream Universe/Game consumers must reference. Without it, each domain would create duplicate resource counters and incompatible process boundaries.
requested_change: Define the smallest stable living-infrastructure contract in kueper-engineering. Cover conserved reservoirs and flows (mass, water, carbon/nutrients, energy), process boundaries for mycology/soil ecology, closed-loop life support, agriculture and waste/recycling, and interface points to the Energy Grid Layer and Mars Settlement Systems Kernel. Reuse the settlement kernel's shared reservoirs instead of introducing parallel counters; state units, fidelity and resilience assumptions; record open assumptions explicitly. Reference the existing mycelium-material research (docs/research/MYCO-0001-pilzbasierte-baustoffe-materialkreislaeufe.md) rather than duplicating it. Do not define game values or canon.
expected_result: kueper-engineering publishes a reviewed living-infrastructure flow/system contract naming reservoirs, process boundaries, units, interfaces and open assumptions, so KG can map canonical terms and Universe/Game can consume the contract without inventing duplicate resource accounting.
